children: Nokia said it is partnering with U.K. cybersecurity consultancy C3IA to jointly deployed advanced communications technologies across U.K. defense operations.

The companies signed a preliminary agreement to collaborate on delivering resilient communications, secure information sharing and network interoperability, the Finnish provider of telecommunications equipment said Wednesday.
The partnership will encompass the land, air, maritime, cyber and space domains, Nokia added.
